# Vendored Plugin Versions

Breadcrumb for re-vendoring these community plugins. To update: download the
release assets (`main.js`, `manifest.json`, `styles.css`) into the plugin's
folder using the URL pattern below, then update the version line.

**Versions are pinned, not latest.** They're pinned to keep the kit's Obsidian
floor at 1.12.2 (newer releases of these plugins require Obsidian 1.13+). When
bumping any of the three plugins, check the new `manifest.json`'s
`minAppVersion` and update the README's stated Obsidian requirement together.

## Templater

- **Version:** 2.20.6 (`minAppVersion` 1.12.2)
- **Downloaded:** 2026-07-26
- **Upstream repo:** https://github.com/SilentVoid13/Templater
- **Release asset URLs:** `https://github.com/SilentVoid13/Templater/releases/download/2.20.6/{main.js,manifest.json,styles.css}` — download all three into `.obsidian/plugins/templater-obsidian/`
